name: cache-warmup
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm with a one-word background request before it expires, with no band

ttl.title: Cache length
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache lives. Auto reads it from the session transcript; or fix it at 1h or 5m.

lead.title: Lead time
lead.description: How long before expiry the ping goes out. Auto is 4 minutes for a 1h cache and 40 seconds for 5m.

idle_cap.title: Stop after idle for
idle_cap.description: Pings stop once you have not sent anything for this long, so a forgotten session does not keep spending.
